suggestions.name: Getting a car insurance quote (OC/AC) and buying it
suggestions.why: "Ubezpieczenie samochodu" (/ubezpieczenia/samochod) links into the calculator; the scan then walked the calculator steps in order: "Kalkulator OC/AC — dane pojazdu" (/kalkulator/pojazd) → "Kalkulator OC/AC — dane kierowcy" (/kalkulator/kierowca) → "Kalkulator OC/AC — opcje" (/kalkulator/opcje), whose button leads to "Twoja składka" (/kalkulator/wynik), and the buy button ends on "Wniosek przyjęty" (/kalkulator/zakup). Error (500) and empty versions of these steps are left out.

suggestions.name: Getting a travel insurance quote
suggestions.why: On "Ubezpieczenie turystyczne" (/ubezpieczenia/podroze) the form's button leads to "Twoja składka podróżna" (/ubezpieczenia/podroze/wynik).

suggestions.name: Comparing products
suggestions.why: "Porównanie produktów" (/porownanie) is linked from the main menu on every page; its button leads to "Wynik porównania" (/porownanie/wynik).

suggestions.name: Sending a message through the contact form
suggestions.why: "Kontakt" (/kontakt) is in the main menu; after filling in the form, its button leads to "Dziękujemy za wiadomość" (/kontakt/dziekujemy).

suggestions.name: Logging in
suggestions.why: "Logowanie" (/logowanie) is linked from every page, and "Moje polisy" sends visitors there; pressing the login button leads to a second "Logowanie" screen (the result of the login attempt).
